messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — in Preview mode for invoice preview I'm seeing tenant T-204's estimated credits ~2x what we expect. Looks like shadowed requests are being counted.
chris: :eyes: Saw similar for a couple tenants. Preview pipeline seems to include events from shadowing and also the live route tags -> duplication.
sasha: Do we have a dedupe key applied? The aggregator groups by (tenant_id, fingerprint) but preview adds a preview_tag so the fingerprint differs.
dennis: Logs from the proxy show headers set twice. Example from staging: route=main-route and route_preview=preview-shadow on the same request before fanout.
maya: Sample trace from staging:
```
I2026-03-18T15:02:11Z proxy req_id=abc123 tenant=T-204 route=main-route route_preview=preview-shadow headers=[X-Preview:true, X-Route:main-route]
event->metering: {tenant:T-204, tokens:45, route:main-route, route_alt:preview-shadow}
```
chris: Ugh. The enrich step flattens both route fields into tags, then the aggregator groups by (tenant, route_tag) -> counted twice.
sasha: Quick fix options:
- ignore events where X-Preview=true at aggregator input
- canonicalize route at proxy so only one route tag is emitted
- change dedupe key to include request_id if present
dennis: I prefer proxy normalization (least brittle). We can drop route_preview before fanout with a tiny edge-proxy change: 
```
if headers.get('X-Preview') == 'true':
    headers.pop('X-Route-Preview', None)
```
maya: Agree. Also need a console UX change: Preview Mode should clearly state "Includes shadowed requests — not an invoice projection" and we should surface the preview duplication metric in the dashboard.
chris: I'll add metric metering.preview_dup_count and a dashboard panel. Plan an alert when preview_dup_count > 0 for 5m :rotating_light:.
sasha: I'll open a fallback PR to tighten dedupe logic in the aggregator (include request_id when present) and add unit tests for preview events.
metering-bot: ticket #MB-452 created: "preview-mode double-counting - proxy normalization + dashboard flag" assigned to dennis, sasha. ETA 2 days.
maya: Plan: roll proxy change as a canary tomorrow, monitor metering.preview_dup_count and invoice-preview deltas. Rollback if preview_dup_count spikes or if invoice-preview error > 1%. OK?
chris: +1
sasha: +1
dennis: +1
maya: thanks — will post short post-rollout note in #eng-platform and update the Preview Mode docs.
